title: Findings & Remediation Management (CAPA)
rationale: Transforms the platform from an evidence repository into an operational compliance system. Directly extends existing Risk, Controls, and Evidence modules.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, when a control fails, I want a remediation ticket (Finding) automatically created and assigned, so that I don't have to manually chase engineering.
acceptance_criteria: System auto-creates a Finding when an Evidence Agent returns 'Fail'.
System auto-creates a Finding when evidence expires.
System auto-creates a Finding when an auditor flags a deficiency.
Finding is linked to the originating Control, Risk, and Evidence.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to assign a remediation owner and set an SLA deadline on a Finding, so that accountability is clear.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can assign a user as the remediation owner.
Manager can set a due date (SLA) for the finding.
Overdue findings are visually flagged on dashboards.

user_stories.story: As a Remediation Owner, I want to document my corrective action plan and attach evidence of the fix, so that the finding can be validated and closed.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can add a description of the corrective action taken.
Owner can upload evidence of remediation.
Owner can submit the finding for verification.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want findings to auto-close when the associated evidence passes again, so that resolved issues don't require manual closure.
acceptance_criteria: When a linked Evidence Agent next returns 'Pass', the Finding is auto-resolved.
An audit log entry records the auto-closure with timestamp and evidence reference.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to track root causes of findings, so that I can identify systemic issues.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can select a root cause category (Process, People, Technology, Policy).
Dashboard shows root cause distribution across all findings.

user_stories.story: As an Org Admin, I want to integrate findings with our project management tool (Jira/Linear/ServiceNow), so that engineering gets tickets in their existing workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can configure a Jira/Linear integration.
When a Finding is created, a corresponding ticket is created in the external tool.
Status syncs bidirectionally (external close → Finding resolves).
